summary: Nusara is Chef Ton Tassanakajohn’s intimate, tasting-menu Thai restaurant in Tha Tien, dedicated to his grandmother and framed around the food traditions of the Rattanakosin and Ayutthaya eras. It is a destination meal beside Wat Pho, rather than a casual stop.
whyGo: A chef-led progression of playful bites and family-style main courses reworks Thai dishes and culinary heritage.

The Old Town location makes it easy to pair dinner with a Wat Pho and riverside day, and the restaurant’s upstairs rooms are known for temple views; ask when booking because seating is not guaranteed.
bestFor: A special-occasion Thai tasting menu and diners curious about contemporary interpretations of historical dishes.
People already exploring Tha Tien, Wat Pho and the Chao Phraya riverfront.
skipIf: You want a quick, inexpensive, à la carte meal or need a flexible arrival time.
You avoid fish sauce, oyster sauce, shrimp paste or dried shrimp; the restaurant says these cannot be omitted or substituted.
duration: Allow about 2.5 hours for dinner, plus travel and time to explore the neighborhood.
cost: Budget around THB 5,990++ per person for the tasting menu based on recent 2026 diner/review references; this is not a price confirmed on the restaurant’s accessible booking page. ‘++’ means taxes/service may be added. Recheck the live menu before committing. Drinks are extra.
hours: Dinner service; the current official site does not expose a clear weekly opening schedule in its text. Confirm available December dates and seating times in TableCheck before planning around it. Last dinner order is listed as 20:30.
bestTime: Book an evening seating if you want the temple-side Old Town atmosphere; choose an earlier slot if combining with Wat Pho, which has its own visiting hours. December is busy travel season, so reserve as soon as your dates are firm.
gettingThere: At 336 Maha Rat Road in Tha Tien, across from Wat Pho. MRT Sanam Chai is the closest rail stop; allow roughly 10–15 minutes on foot, depending on route and traffic. Tha Tien pier is nearby for river crossings. Use a taxi/ride-hail for the final leg if heat, mobility or late-night transit is a concern. The restaurant lists limited first-come street parking and paid options at Wat Pho or the Royal Thai Navy Club.
booking: Reserve via the official site’s TableCheck link. The restaurant requires full prepayment at booking, says bookings are non-refundable, and requests changes at least seven business days ahead; its policy describes an 80% refund where applicable. Vegetarian menu is available only by advance request. Tell them about allergies when booking; last-minute accommodations may not be possible. All guests, including children, take the set menu. Smart casual dress; no flip-flops or tank tops.
accessibility: Not established from the restaurant’s published information. The official site describes multiple dining floors and does not explain step-free access or accessible toilets; contact the restaurant before booking if stairs or other access needs matter.
practicalTips: Build in time to arrive: the restaurant says it may hold a table for only 20 minutes and a late arrival can shorten the meal.
Tell the restaurant about allergies and dietary requirements at reservation time; vegetarian dining needs advance arrangement.
The official reservation page currently lists a THB 2,000++ corkage charge per standard bottle and a THB 60,000++ minimum spend for the private dining room.
Request a Wat Pho-facing table if that matters to you, but the restaurant does not guarantee specific seating.
decemberNotes: For December 2026, treat availability, menu price and seating times as unconfirmed until checked on the live reservation page. The restaurant requires advance prepayment, so review its cancellation terms and your exact date before paying. No December-specific event or special menu was confirmed.
uncertainties: Official menu and tasting-menu PDF links are live, but their contents were not readable in the source browser; THB 5,990++ is an indicative recent diner/review price, not an official current quote.
The restaurant’s published text does not provide a complete weekly schedule, transit directions, or accessibility details.
